title: Abba bar Kappara
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman writes that we find in Kohelet Rabbah, chapter 1, end of section 3, that Bar Kappara’s name was Abba; see the entry Bar Kappara.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Torat Emet Kohelet Rabbah 1:3 paragraph explicitly says “Abba bar Kappara said to Rabbi.” This is the local digital wording alongside Hyman’s statement about Bar Kappara’s name. Hyman’s end-of-section locator and cross-reference remain literal; no further name or identity binding is made.
